text: Dear group, I already raised this question in a recent past, but I have concerns about the clash of answers to my post with reality of recent multiple posts about family members being denied entrance to Israel. Therefore I am asking again: someone here knows how to proceed with my sister/parents/cousins coming to visit us from Czech Republic? All of them already visited in the past, but it was prior of ongoing wars (before 2023) and since then nobody visited. Now they are considering the visit again, but I am concerned about all the people from Europe who normally are able to enter as tourists only with ETA-IL, now being denied entry to Israel without official notification and permission from MH… last time I asked this question people were not concerned, but since then I did read stories about family members from Georgia or Romania or even France having troubles and being denied entry or banned from future visits. What is the correct procedure here? Someone from Czechia had visits recently? What did you do and how it went?
